SaaS AI Start-Up revolutionizing the way businesses leverage artificial intelligence.


Founded in 2019, we are a fast growing SaaS AI Start-Up revolutionizing the way businesses leverage artificial intelligence to drive efficiency and innovation. Abacus.AI is the world’s first AI super assistant built on our state-of-the-art generative AI technology. We are headquartered in San Francisco, with a dynamic team spread across the world.
